newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope chooses justice theme for world peace day.
newsitem.headline: Pope chooses justice theme for world peace day.

text.p: Pope John Paul has chosen human rights and justice as the theme of the Roman Catholic Church's World Day of Peace for next year, the Vatican said on Friday.
It said the Pope's message for the day, which the church marks each January 1, would be titled: "From justice for everyone peace is born."
"The theme brings up and demands the personal responsability of each man and woman to build a human world based on justice," the statement said.
The message is released several months before and is sent to heads and state and governments around the world.
Last year the Pope urged the world to make 1997 a year of love and reconciliation, making forgiveness the centre point of his January 1 address.
